A trusted catalyst for carbon removal
Enabling high-integrity carbon removal solutions through project development and market integration
GET IN TOUCH
Services

Carbon removal is becoming an pivotal part of credible net-zero strategies. Accend provides CDR suppliers with practical support from feasibility and project design through LCA, certification, and commercialization. Our approach is tailored to each project’s technical and operational needs. With more than 5 years in the CDR market, we have built a strong delivery track record, with volumes delivered fully matching volumes sold. We also support companies' decarbonization efforts  by sourcing high-integrity carbon removal credits, structuring offtake agreements, and building diversified CDR portfolios aligned with their net-zero goals.

01 PROCURING CREDITS
Carbon Removal Credits

 We offer spot and forward access to high-integrity carbon removal credits from a diversified portfolio of ~20 projects across Europe, North America, and APAC. Our close, on-the-ground involvement with project developers enables rigorous vetting and quality control, while portfolio diversification provides flexibility and continuity across supply. 

EXPLORE PROJECTS
02 ENSURING INTEGRITY
Carbon Project Development & dMRV

 We help valorize and monetize high-integrity carbon removal within projects, acting as carbon removal project developers from feasibility and methodology alignment through to credit issuance. Leveraging best-in-class dMRV, we ensure robust traceability and accountability. We work with leading standards — including as a Puro.earth-accredited partner and C-sink trader — to bring projects to certification and market. 

GET IN TOUCH
03 MEASURING IMPACT
Life Cycle Assessment

Measuring net impact is critical. We perform Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) that meet ISO standards 14040, 14044, and 14067, as well as global carbon removal methodologies, ensuring accurate and credible carbon accounting.

LEARN MORE
04 NAVIGATING THE MARKET
Market Intelligence & Strategy

 We provide market intelligence and strategic guidance to suppliers and buyers navigating the carbon removal landscape — from certification frameworks, registries and evolving regulations to pricing dynamics and market trends. Drawing on over 5 years of experience and direct engagement across the ecosystem, we bring a grounded, real-world understanding of projects and market developments.
